Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities Implement the Global Organizational Structure and Roles & Responsibilities Blueprint. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Competencies and Professional Background Target Audience: Managers & Directors Bachelor's degree in a related discipline, or equivalent experience 5+ years in account management, service delivery, or operations within BPO/customer service, including 2+ years leading managers across multiple sites or countries Six Sigma certification with DMAIC experience preferred Proficient in Google Workspace applications (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Keep/Drive) and comfortable working with data and reporting tools English proficiency at CEFR C1/C2 Key Competencies Builds relationships quickly and influences senior stakeholders Strong leadership, able to challenge constructively Structured, organized, and analytical, with strategic thinking Hands-on and solution-oriented under pressure Strong client focus and team collaboration
